ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLKDIV
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Core clock divider. Slows down subsequent SPI transactions by a factor of (CLKDIV+1) relative to the core clock frequency. The period of sck, T(sck) then becomes `2*(CLK_DIV+1)*T(core)`

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CSNIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minimum idle time between commands. Indicates the minimum number of sck half-cycles to hold cs_n high between commands. Setting this register to zero creates a minimally-wide CS_N-high pulse of one-half sck cycle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CSNTRAIL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: CS_N Trailing Time. Indicates the number of half sck cycles, CSNTRAIL+1, to leave between last edge of sck and the rising edge of cs_n. Setting this register to zero corresponds to the minimum delay of one-half sck cycle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CSNLEAD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: CS_N Leading Time. Indicates the number of half sck cycles, CSNLEAD+1, to leave between the falling edge of cs_n and the first edge of sck. Setting this register to zero corresponds to the minimum delay of one-half sck cycle

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FULLCYC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Full cycle. Modifies the CPHA sampling behaviour to allow for longer device logic setup times. Rather than sampling the SD bus a half cycle after shifting out data, the data is sampled a full cycle after shifting data out. This means that if CPHA = 0, data is shifted out on the trailing edge, and sampled a full cycle later. If CPHA = 1, data is shifted and sampled with the trailing edge, also separated by a full cycle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CPHA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The phase of the sck clock signal relative to the data. When CPHA = 0, the data changes on the trailing edge of sck and is typically sampled on the leading edge. Conversely if CPHA = 1 high, data lines change on the leading edge of sck and are typically sampled on the trailing edge. CPHA should be chosen to match the phase of the selected device. The sampling behavior is modified by the !!CONFIGOPTS.FULLCYC bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CPOL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The polarity of the sck clock signal. When CPOL is 0, sck is low when idle, and emits high pulses. When CPOL is 1, sck is high when idle, and emits a series of low pulses.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CSID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Chip Select ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CSAAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: **C**hip **S**elect **A**ctive **A**fter **T**ransaction. If !!COMMAND.CSAAT = 0, the chip select line is raised immediately at the end of the command segment. If !!COMMAND.CSAAT = 1, the chip select line is left low at the end of the current transaction segment. This allows the creation of longer, more complete SPI transactions, consisting of several separate segments for issuing instructions, pausing for dummy cycles, and transmitting or receiving data from the device.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SPEED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The speed for this command segment: "0" = Standard SPI. "1" = Dual SPI. "2"=Quad SPI, "3": RESERVED.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DIRECTION
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The direction for the following command: "0" = Dummy cycles (no TX/RX). "1" = Rx only, "2" = Tx only, "3" = Bidirectional Tx/Rx (Standard SPI mode only).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Segment Length.
For read or write segments, this field controls the number of 1-byte bursts to transmit and or receive in this command segment. The number of cycles required to send or received a byte will depend on !!COMMAND.SPEED. For dummy segments, (!!COMMAND.DIRECTION == 0), this register controls the number of dummy cycles to issue. The number of bytes (or dummy cycles) in the segment will be equal to !!COMMAND.LEN + 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OVERFLOW

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNDERFLOW

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMDINVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Invalid Command Errors: If this bit is set, the block sends an error interrupt whenever a command is sent with invalid values for !!COMMAND.SPEED or !!COMMAND.DIRECTION.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CSIDINVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Invalid CSID: If this bit is set, the block sends an error interrupt whenever a command is submitted, but CSID exceeds NumCS.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXFULL

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXEMPTY

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Assert to send a spi_event interrupt whenever !!STATUS.READY goes high

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Assert to send a spi_event interrupt whenever !!STATUS.ACTIVE goes low

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: sep_external
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: SEP external address map (eFuse SHIM control and execute-in-place window).

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: efuse_shim_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: eFuse SHIM Control Model Address Map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: DV model of the eFuse SHIM control interface.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_BANK_INIT_TIME
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse bank initialization time. Number of cycles to wait for the OTP macro to initialize before sensing can begin.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: init_time
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Most OTP have a initialization time before sensing can be done

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: pic
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: VeeR EL2 Programmable Interrupt Controller (PIC) memory-mapped registers. Supports up to PIC_TOTAL_INT external interrupt sources with 15 priority levels.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: meipl
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: External Interrupt Priority Level Register. Sets the priority level for an interrupt source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: intpriority
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: External interrupt priority level: RISC-V standard order: 0=Never interrupt, 1..15=Priority (1 lowest, 15 highest) Reverse order: 15=Never interrupt, 14..0=Priority (14 lowest, 0 highest)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: meip
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: External Interrupt Pending Register. Reports pending status of up to 32 interrupt sources.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: intpend
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: External interrupt pending bits. Bit Y indicates pending status for source X*32+Y. 0: Interrupt not pending 1: Interrupt pending

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: meie
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: External Interrupt Enable Register. Controls interrupt enable for a single source.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: inten
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: External interrupt enable: 0: Interrupt disabled 1: Interrupt enabled

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: mpiccfg
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: PIC Configuration Register. Used to select the operational parameters of the PIC.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: priord
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Priority order: 0: RISC-V standard compliant priority order (0=lowest to 15=highest) 1: Reverse priority order (15=lowest to 0=highest)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: meigwctrl
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: External Interrupt Gateway Configuration Register. Controls interrupt type and polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: polarity
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: External interrupt polarity: 0: Active-high interrupt 1: Active-low interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: irq_type
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: External interrupt type: 0: Level-triggered interrupt 1: Edge-triggered interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: meigwclr
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: External Interrupt Gateway Clear Register. Writing any value clears the gateway's interrupt pending (IP) bit for edge-triggered interrupts.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write any value to clear the interrupt pending bit in the gateway. This register is write-only; reads return 0.
